item.description: monoblog has a new look and a new engine, or no engine. Like monointerferenz the blog was based on Jekyll. But I wanted less. No dependencies, no deployment. So here we are. Simple, handwritten html files. Just a small script handles the rss feed, the tag system and the index page. It runs locally, gets not deployed. Just me, a script and an editor..
